Subject: Interested in reserved capacity / throughput demo

Hi Redwood team,

We just completed a self-serve evaluation and can see immediate value in a Dedicated/Reserved capacity deployment for our production inference. We're QuantumEdge (edge analytics for IoT) and a few notes up front so you can match the right folks: 

- Workload: mixed chat + high-rate scoring for sensor telemetry (real-time reranking + summarization)
- Peak concurrent streams: ~140 concurrent requests, average request ~250 tokens, peak bursts up to 700 tokens
- Desired p99 latency (generation): <= 350ms for scoring path; interactive chat can tolerate up to 800ms
- Monthly token estimate: 450M tokens, with spiky daily patterns

Can we schedule a short technical screen/demo to validate capacity sizing and latency SLOs? Prefer next week morning PST.

I've attached a short infra requirements doc (high level).

Thanks,
Julia Park
Head of ML Engineering
QuantumEdge
